messages.text: Want to talk with management
Handed to the team · customer asked for a person

Ill wait. I have been told they'll email me now about 5 times- not falling for that again.

Fair enough, and I'm sorry you've been left hanging that many times. The team is on right now, so stay in this chat and one of them will come in here directly.

While you wait, tell me what it's about. If it's something I can answer or fix myself, I'd rather get it done now than have you wait again.
